verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a VPN and network-connectivity platform, so committing and pushing code is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Tailscale itself shipping git commit or push functionality. Testimonials about SSH-ing into machines or coding remotely over the tailnet describe connectivity used alongside separate tools, not a source-control capability of the product.

support.subject: As a developer, I can commit and push changes directly from my device
